message:
We all know that being prepared is key to feeling calm and in control, especially when it comes to our kiddos. That's why we love the resources from Ready.gov! They have some fantastic tips for teaching kids about emergency preparedness in a fun and engaging way. 

It's never too early to start the conversation, and this guide helps us make sure our little ones know what to do in different situations. After all, a little knowledge goes a long way in building confidence. 

What are some of your favorite ways to involve your kids in preparedness planning? 🛠️
